The '''Qieg''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insect/Legends|insectoids]] [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]].

==Biology and appearance==
They had a segmented body with three sections. The species had six [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] with one set of arms and two sets of legs. The feet on the front set of legs were jointed and could be used to grasp objects. There were several different Qieg races, differentiated by shell color. They communicated by a series of clicks, chirps and mandible motions.<ref name="AE" /> Their vocal cords could approximate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Binary/Legends|binary]] and some Qieg were capable of speaking it. To communicate in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Qieg would wear electronic masks that could reproduce the vocal ranges of [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="AJ1">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
The [[Qieg religion]] was practiced on the [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]]. The [[Gender/Legends|males and females]] had equal roles in society, and children were not claimed by any parent but raised communally. Qieg culture was focused on the hive and de-emphasized individuality.<ref name="AE" /> Some Qieg lived in [[Shulell City|Shulell]] but most lived in hollowed-out [[Cactus/Legends|cacti]] in the forests.<ref name="AJ1" />
